name: plugin-raven-verify
description: ElizaOS plugin: pre-action Solana token verification via Raven — signed, scope-bounded on-chain evidence receipts (checks performed, checks NOT performed, coverage gaps, ed25519 signature). Reports evidence, never a safe/unsafe verdict or trading advice.
author: Raven (https://ravenattest.com)

RAVEN_API_KEY.description: Raven hosted-verifier API key. Request at https://raven-launch-console.vercel.app/request-access.html

SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint, used to resolve the owning token program for a mint before verification.

RAVEN_VERIFIER_URL.description: Raven verifier base URL (override only if self-hosting).
